issues.t: Driveshaft center support bearing failure
issues.sym: A rumble, clunk or vibration from under the middle of the vehicle, often felt through the floor when pulling away or at highway speed.
issues.why: The rubber center support (carrier) bearing on the two-piece rear driveshaft breaks down with age. It is one of the most-reported problems on early Touaregs, and if ignored the driveshaft itself can be damaged.
issues.next: Have the driveshaft inspected soon. Many shops replace the support bearing alone, but if the shaft is damaged the whole driveshaft must be replaced.

issues.t: In-tank fuel pump failure
issues.sym: Hard starting, stalling, sputtering under load, or an engine that cranks but will not start.
issues.why: First-generation Touaregs use two in-tank fuel pumps, and either can wear out or clog. Fuel pumps are the second most-reported repair in owner surveys.
issues.next: Have fuel pressure tested before replacing parts. Shops often replace both pumps and the filter at once since the labor overlaps.

issues.t: Air suspension leaks and compressor failure
issues.sym: One corner or the whole vehicle sags after sitting, a suspension warning light, the compressor running often, or the height adjustment not working.
issues.why: Vehicles with the optional air suspension have rubber air springs that crack and leak with age, and the compressor then wears out from running constantly.
issues.next: Have a shop find the leaking spring before replacing the compressor, or the new compressor will fail too. Some owners convert to conventional springs.

issues.t: Transfer case wear and actuator failure
issues.sym: A 4WD or low-range warning light, clunking, binding in tight turns, or failure to shift into low range.
issues.why: The transfer case can wear early, and the small stepper motor that controls it is prone to failing.
issues.next: Check the transfer case fluid and have the codes read. A failed actuator motor is far cheaper than a new transfer case, so get a proper diagnosis first.

issues.t: Rough or erratic automatic shifting
issues.sym: Harsh or delayed shifts, slipping, or flaring between gears, especially when cold.
issues.why: Early Touareg automatics are known for rough shifting. Worn valve bodies and old fluid cause many of the faults.
issues.next: Have the fluid level checked and the transmission adaptations reset with a scan tool. If slipping continues, a valve body repair or rebuild may be needed.

issues.t: Water pump and thermostat failure
issues.sym: Coolant leaks at the front of the engine, a sweet smell, an overheating warning, or the temperature needle swinging.
issues.why: Water pumps and thermostats wear out, and on the V8 the job involves removing much of the front of the vehicle. A stuck thermostat can cause overheating.
issues.next: Stop driving if it overheats. On the V8, replace the water pump, thermostat and timing belt together to save on labor.

issues.t: Ignition coil failure and misfires
issues.sym: Rough idle, shaking under acceleration and a flashing check engine light.
issues.why: Individual ignition coils on the gasoline engines fail with age and heat.
issues.next: Have the misfire code read and replace the failed coil. Do not drive hard with a flashing light, since it can damage the catalytic converters.

issues.t: Catalytic converter failure
issues.sym: Check engine light with catalyst efficiency codes, misfire under load, a rattle from underneath, or a sulfur smell.
issues.why: Catalytic converters on the gasoline engines are a common replacement, often after misfires or leaking secondary-air (combi) valves damage them.
issues.next: Fix any misfires first, then have the converters tested. Aftermarket converters cost less but must be legal in your state.

issues.t: PCV valve failure and oil consumption
issues.sym: Using more oil than normal, blue smoke, a whistle at idle, or oil leaks around valve covers.
issues.why: The crankcase vent (PCV) valve fails and lets crankcase pressure push oil into the intake and out of seals.
issues.next: Replacing the PCV valve is inexpensive and often fixes high oil use and new leaks.

issues.t: No-crank from corroded wiring or power relay
issues.sym: Turn the key and nothing happens, or the starter clicks; sometimes a fuel pump keeps running with the key off.
issues.why: Owners of high-mileage early Touaregs report corroded or melted wiring and failed power relays in the starting circuit.
issues.next: Have the starting circuit tested by a shop that knows these vehicles before replacing the starter.

issues.t: Keyless entry door handle sensors fail
issues.sym: Doors will not unlock when you touch the handle, keyless start does not see the key, or locking works only from the remote.
issues.why: The proximity sensors in the door handles and the keyless entry control module can fail.
issues.next: Use the key blade or remote for now. A shop can find which handle or module is faulty and replace only that part.

issues.t: Sunroof drains clog and leak water inside
issues.sym: Wet headliner, damp carpets, water in the footwells, or electrical faults after rain.
issues.why: The sunroof drain tubes clog with debris or come loose, so rainwater overflows into the cabin.
issues.next: Clear the drains with low air pressure or a trimmer line, and dry the carpets quickly to prevent mold and wiring damage.

issues.t: Blower motor failure
issues.sym: The fan works only on some speeds, makes a whirring noise, or stops blowing completely.
issues.why: The HVAC blower motor wears out and is a common repair in owner surveys.
issues.next: Have the blower motor and its control module tested. Replacing the motor usually fixes it.

issues.t: Headlight bulb failures
issues.sym: A bulb-out warning, a dark or flickering headlight.
issues.why: Headlight bulbs, especially xenon bulbs, fail regularly on the Touareg and are a top-five repair in owner surveys.
issues.next: Replace bulbs in pairs. If a xenon light stays dark with a new bulb, have the igniter or ballast checked.

issues.t: ABS wheel speed sensor failure
issues.sym: ABS, traction control and sometimes air suspension warning lights come on together.
issues.why: A wheel speed sensor or its wiring fails, and several systems that rely on it switch off.
issues.next: Have the codes read to find which wheel. The brakes still work normally, but ABS and stability control will not until it is fixed.

issues.t: Fuel filter flange can crack and leak (recall)
issues.sym: A fuel smell around the vehicle or a wet spot near the fuel tank area.
issues.why: The flange on top of the fuel pump/filter can crack and leak fuel, a fire risk. VW recalled these vehicles under NHTSA campaign 17V-583.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. The dealer inspects the flange and replaces it or fits a protective cover, free of charge.

issues.t: Fuel filter flange can leak on 2007-2010 models (recall)
issues.sym: A fuel smell or wet spot near the fuel tank area.
issues.why: A separate recall, NHTSA campaign 17V-151, covers the same cracking fuel filter flange on later first-generation Touaregs.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. The dealer replaces the flange if needed and adds a protective cover, free of charge.

issues.t: Roof spoiler can come loose (recall)
issues.sym: Rattling from the top of the tailgate, or a spoiler that moves when pushed.
issues.why: The struts that hold the roof edge spoiler can crack, so the spoiler can loosen and fly off. VW recalled these vehicles under NHTSA campaign 09V-248.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. The dealer installs reinforcement wedges free of charge.

issues.t: Fuel supply line may not seal (recall)
issues.sym: A fuel smell in the engine bay.
issues.why: A fuel supply line changed during production may not seal properly at its connector, a fire risk. VW recalled these vehicles under NHTSA campaign 08V-035.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the line inspected and replaced for free.

issues.t: Seat belts may not lock for child seats (recall)
issues.sym: A seat belt that will not stay locked when tightening a child seat.
issues.why: Some seat belt retractors can switch off the automatic locking mode used to hold child seats. VW recalled these vehicles under NHTSA campaign 04V-592.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. The dealer replaces the affected retractors free of charge.

issues.t: Rear seat belt latch bolt may be loose (recall)
issues.sym: Nothing you will notice until a crash.
issues.why: The rear seat belt buckle attachment bolt may not have been riveted properly. VW recalled these vehicles under NHTSA campaign 04V-233.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the buckle repaired free of charge.

issues.t: Tire pressure monitor wiring can short (recall)
issues.sym: The tire pressure warning light may come on or the system may stop working.
issues.why: The tire pressure monitoring harness could rub on the parking brake cable spring and short to ground, a possible fire risk. VW recalled these vehicles under NHTSA campaign 03V-266.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the harness rerouted free of charge.

issues.t: Water gets into the air filter and can stall the engine
issues.sym: A wet or rotting air filter, water in the air box, hesitation, limp mode, a check engine light or, after heavy rain, the engine shaking and stalling.
issues.why: The drain valve in the engine air intake can clog, letting rainwater collect in the air filter housing. VW issued a service bulletin (23DG). In the worst case water can reach the engine.
issues.next: Check the air filter after heavy rain. Have the intake drain cleared and ask a dealer about bulletin 23DG. Do not drive through deep water.

issues.t: Diesel emissions settlement fix or buyback
issues.sym: You may notice nothing, or a change in power or fuel economy after the emissions fix.
issues.why: The 3.0L TDI was part of the VW diesel emissions settlement. 2009-2012 Touareg TDIs were offered a buyback, and 2013-2016 models an approved emissions modification.
issues.next: Ask a VW dealer whether the emissions fix has been done on your VIN. Unfixed vehicles may fail inspection in some states.

issues.t: AdBlue (DEF) heater or pump failure
issues.sym: An AdBlue or emissions warning, often with a countdown of miles before the engine will not restart.
issues.why: The heater and pump in the diesel exhaust fluid (AdBlue) tank fail often. It is the single most-reported problem on the Touareg in TrueDelta owner surveys.
issues.next: Do not let the countdown run out. Get the system diagnosed quickly; the heater or the whole tank module is usually replaced.

issues.t: EGR cooler or valve failure
issues.sym: Coolant loss with no visible leak, white exhaust smoke, a check engine light or loss of power.
issues.why: The exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) cooler on the TDI can crack internally and leak coolant, and EGR valves clog with soot.
issues.next: Watch the coolant level. If it keeps dropping, have the EGR cooler pressure-tested before the engine overheats.

issues.t: Brake pedal pivot pin clip may be missing (recall)
issues.sym: Nothing you will notice until the pin works loose.
issues.why: The brake pedal pivot pin may be missing its securing clip, so the pin can move and the pedal can come off its mount. VW recalled these vehicles under NHTSA campaign 16V-170.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. The dealer inspects the pedal and installs a clip if needed, free of charge.

issues.t: Tire pressure warning may not work (recall)
issues.sym: The tire pressure light may not come on when a tire is low.
issues.why: The tire pressure monitoring system may have been calibrated wrong, and the tire pressure label is incorrect. VW recalled these vehicles under NHTSA campaign 16V-243.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the system recalibrated and labels replaced free of charge.

issues.t: Hybrid battery tray can hold water and short (recall)
issues.sym: A hybrid system warning light, or no warning at all.
issues.why: The tray under the high-voltage hybrid battery may not drain water, which can cause a short circuit and a fire risk. VW recalled Touareg Hybrids for this (VW code 53B8).
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the dealer fix the battery tray drain free of charge.

issues.t: Hybrid fuel injection system can leak (recall)
issues.sym: A fuel smell from the engine bay.
issues.why: The fuel injection system on the 2012 Touareg Hybrid could leak fuel, raising fire risk. VW recalled it (VW code 24BK).
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the repair done for free.
